author: paconhpa
body:
The right column cycles the lights "to the right"
Left column cycles "to the left"

Choose a column hit top arrow until top 2 lights are lit. Hit bottom arrow until bottom lights are lit.  Middle arrow can be ignored.

author: capfedhill
body:
The goal is to highlight the 4 darker-outlined small squares. Each set of left/right arrows move the top/middle/bottom larger square to the left or right.

Basically you just need to click the top left arrow until the top large square highlights 2 of the small squares.

Then click the bottom left arrow until the lower large square highlights the other 2 small squares (and it'll be solved).

Very rarely will you need to mess with the middle square / middle set of arrows -- only needed if it's not possible to highlight the top / bottom with those matching set of arrows.

author: aminali_xz
body:
Dude, this is the easiest puzzle.

The two up arrows affect two upper pieces, and the two down arrows affect two lower pieces.

If the four pieces in the up and down positions are correct and glowing, the puzzle will be solved. For example, if the two upper pieces are correct, don’t mess with them; focus on the two lower pieces. Use the arrows until they are correct, and the puzzle will be solved.

So, mess with the two upper pieces until they are correct, then move on to the other two.

author: Thizz650
body:
Top pair of arrows change the top 2 squares
the bottom pair of arrows change the bottom 2 squares.
The middle changes either all, or the middle 2 squares 

A really easy way to solve this is to determine which 2 squares need to be highlighted. (Top=top; bottom=bottom) I only use the middle pair of arrows when i need the middle 2 squares OR i need more than 2 squares. I just spam either direction and it solves itself

  easiest puzzle door

author: snoopyb137
body:
I didn't get it forever... Then watched an old shabbash video where he had the solution to it... It was actually incredibly easy and is now my favorite.

It's only 4 squares that light up.

Just:
- get either the top 2 or bottom 2 to light up.
- then spam the button that is furthest from whatever squares you got lit on the opposite side.

It completes it within a second or so.
